Data Streaming

1. What is Data Streaming?
  • Data streaming allows high-throughput ingestion of data into Ignite caches;
  • The IgniteDataStreamer batches and parallelizes writes automatically;
  • Much faster than individual cache.put() calls for bulk loading;
2. Basic Data Streaming
  • try (IgniteDataStreamer<Integer, String> streamer = ignite.dataStreamer("myCache")) {
    streamer.perNodeBufferSize(1024);      // buffer size per node
    streamer.perNodeParallelOperations(8); // parallel operations per node

    for (int i = 0; i < 1_000_000; i++) {
        streamer.addData(i, "value-" + i);
    }
} // auto-flush on close
  • The streamer buffers entries and sends them in batches to the nodes that own the partitions;
3. Streamer Configuration
ParameterDescriptionDefault
perNodeBufferSizeEntries buffered per node before flushing1024
perNodeParallelOperationsConcurrent operations per node16
allowOverwriteIf true, existing entries are overwritten; if false, they are skippedfalse
autoFlushFrequencyMilliseconds between auto-flushes (0 = disabled)0
4. Stream Receiver (Custom Processing)
  • Use a StreamReceiver to process entries on the receiving node before storing: 
    streamer.receiver(StreamTransformer.from((entry, args) -> {
    // Transform the value before storing
    String original = entry.getValue();
    entry.setValue(original.toUpperCase());
    return null;
}));
5. Kafka Integration
  • Ignite provides a Kafka streamer module for consuming Kafka topics directly into caches: 
    KafkaStreamer<Integer, String> kafkaStreamer = new KafkaStreamer<>();

kafkaStreamer.setIgnite(ignite);
kafkaStreamer.setTopic("my-topic");
kafkaStreamer.setThreads(4);
kafkaStreamer.setConsumerConfig(kafkaProperties);

kafkaStreamer.start();
  • Requires the ignite-kafka module;
6. When to Use Streaming vs. Regular Puts
  • Use streaming for bulk loading (initial data load, batch imports, ETL pipelines);
  • Use regular puts for individual transactional operations;
  • Streaming is not transactional — it provides at-least-once semantics;
